_usage: Where a record opens in its source system (operating.alert_playbooks.source_links). A record's system is chosen by its binding prefix; its page by its record type. The base URL comes from the environment variable named in base_env and must be https; while it is unset, or a type has no page, the link is not_configured (never guessed). BC pages are the standard web client card pages; {number} is the record's cited number. Portal and FileMaker record pages are not known yet: add them here when their URL patterns are confirmed.
